ctags.name: actions
ctags.pattern: /^    const actions = Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, i) => messageAction(`Button ${i}`));$/

ctags.name: body
ctags.pattern: /^    const body = card.body as { contents: Array<{ text: string }> };$/

ctags.name: body
ctags.pattern: /^    const body = card.body as { contents: Array<{ type: string }> };$/

ctags.name: body
ctags.pattern: /^    const body = card.body as { contents: Array<{ type: string; contents?: unknown[] }> };$/

ctags.name: bubbles
ctags.pattern: /^    const bubbles = Array.from({ length: 15 }, (_, i) => createInfoCard(`Card ${i}`, `Body ${i}`/

ctags.name: column
ctags.pattern: /^    const column = createCarouselColumn({ text: longText, actions: [messageAction("OK")] });$/

ctags.name: columns
ctags.pattern: /^    const columns = (template.template as { columns: Array<{ actions: Array<{ type: string }> }>/

ctags.name: footer
ctags.pattern: /^    const footer = card.footer as { contents: Array<{ text: string }> };$/

ctags.name: footer
ctags.pattern: /^    const footer = card.footer as { contents: unknown[] };$/

ctags.name: items
ctags.pattern: /^    const items = Array.from({ length: 15 }, (_, i) => ({ title: `Item ${i}` }));$/

ctags.name: listBox
ctags.pattern: /^    const listBox = body.contents[2] as { contents: unknown[] };$/
